g.text: WHICH RESEARCH GAPS ARE NARROWING, AND WHICH ARE NOT
LMIC research share in 2010–2012 (dot) and 2021–2023 (arrowhead), each divided by the same 2021–2023 share of DALYs.
The matched line marks proportional research and burden shares.
Latest dataset: 41,610 included records. Research base: 527 disease-coded LMIC records in 2010–2012 and 2,033 in 2021–2023; a record can contribute to several
disease rows, but only once to All injuries. Rows are grouped by GBD level 1 and ordered within groups by summed LMIC DALYs across 2010–2023. The injury row
includes all three level-2 injury causes and records naming an injury without its cause. Unspecified infections cannot be assigned to a level-2 row and are
omitted unless another plotted cause is named. Both research periods use pooled 2021–2023 DALY shares as their fixed reference. Closer/farther compares the
absolute percentage-point gap to that reference, including movement above or across the matched line. Country studied and publication-year income define
research settings; burden-year income defines LMIC DALYs. No minimum-count rows are dropped; this is a descriptive comparison without uncertainty intervals.
